title: Add and reorder funnel steps
blurb: Build a multi-step funnel, like opt-in page then thank you page.

steps.title: Open your funnel
steps.body: Click the funnel you want to build out. The **Steps** tab lists each page in the order visitors see them.

steps.title: Add a step
steps.body: Click **Add New Step**. Give it a name, like **Thank You**, and a short path, like **thank-you**. Then click to create it.

steps.title: Change the order
steps.body: Drag steps up or down in the list. When someone submits a form or clicks a button set to go to the next step, they land on the step below.

steps.title: Build the new step
steps.body: Select the new step and click **Edit** to design it, or choose a template for it.

steps.title: Test the whole path
steps.body: Open the first step in **Preview** and go through it like a customer to check each page leads to the next.
steps.tip: Use a real email so you also see any follow-up messages.
